recording.lineage: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP1s X-Y @ 90degrees w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2 bisecting the X-Y Pair> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Front Row of Lawn 8 foot stand | The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
